rationale: Six distinct local episodes in five regions, each with official publication day, explicit event day/period, municipal geography. Source-only convenience sample frozen before matching; no claim comprehensive or representative.
capture_limitation: Web tool text snapshots preserve returned extraction, not raw HTML or guaranteed full page; source pages may have subsequently changed.
timing_policy: Date strings are day precision; publication clocks not timezone normalized. Report-receipt days are explicit incident days, not exact physical onset. Unknown ends blank. Category hints are unverified possible mechanisms, not observed expenditure labels.
